name: MBUToken
fix_description: In the deposit function (0x47e7ef24), the internal price calculation (0x371b) for converting WBNB to USDT value does not divide by the token decimals, resulting in a massively inflated USDT amount. This causes excessive MBU minting. Fix by normalizing decimals consistently across all price calculations in the deposit path.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit: wrap BNB, call a single vulnerable deposit function, then dump the incorrectly received tokens via PancakeSwap. It involves only a couple of external interactions and no complex flash loans, stateful multi-transaction reasoning, or deep protocol-specific mechanics.
